title: Gate at a circuit layer
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit that uses only identity, negation, and unbounded fan-in conjunction gates. For a layer $m$ below the circuit depth and a node $u$ in layer $m+1$, define its associated directed acyclic graph gate by reading the gate’s shape: an identity wire becomes a one-input AND gate, a negation becomes a NOT gate, and a conjunction becomes an AND gate whose inputs are the corresponding layer vertices, with repeated inputs removed.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ uses only the standard gate operations
